title: Layout discovery: omniagent repo core components
prompt:
Canonical corpus task (id t01, shape: project-layout discovery). In the omniagent repo (container path /app, host path /opt/workspace/omniagent) locate these five components and report the repo-relative file path for each, one numbered line per component:
1. The core agent main loop module (runs the per-iteration agent cycle).
2. The Rust prompt plugin (mcp-server-prompt) crate entry module under plugins/tools/prompt.
3. The search tool plugin entry module (defines handle_search_messages and handle_search_wiki).
4. The notes tool module (implements note_write, note_append, note_read).
5. The compaction module (implements the compact-messages null contract).
Rules: bounded discovery only; use filesystem_search and filesystem_list (a handful of calls); confirm each candidate path exists with filesystem_info before you report it; do not read file contents; do not modify anything.
Expected final answer: exactly five numbered lines 'N. <repo-relative-path>' using paths relative to the repo root, for example 'src/agent/main_loop.rs'. If you cannot confirm a component, still give your best path and append '(unverified)'.
note: Waste shape: project-layout discovery (E1/E4). Success = agent names real repo-relative paths, found by bounded search, without reading file bodies.
